newsitem.title: UK: United News up as BZW highlights upgrade.
newsitem.headline: United News up as BZW highlights upgrade.

text.p: Shares in United News & Media Plc rose on Wednesday as analysts at BZW repeated their recent upgrade on the stock, dealers said.
United shares were up 6p at 759-1/2 by 1030 GMT, near its record 772p set on March 17, in thin volume of 84,805 shares.
BZW raised the stock to "buy" from "hold" and upped its pre-tax profit estimate to 336.2 million stg for 1997 and 378.7 million stg for the year after, dealers said.
The move came after the group last week posted a 12 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 290.2 million stg and said the merger of MAI and United News was paying off.
Analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment. They first alerted the market to their more positive view on United shares on Monday.
